annotations.title: Get the Round Pack of forecasts

description: Paid (5.00 USDC per call); free alternatives: list_fixtures and the Match of the Round forecast. For "predictions for all this weekend's games" or "which games will be draws?" in the Premier League, Championship, League 1 or League 2. Forecasts for every fixture in the next 7 days, in one call: fixtureId, kick-off, league, teams and the forecast (chances, expected goals), or null when not published yet. Use this when you want the whole round or a "which games" answer: period, day, dates, league and team narrow it; sort (confidence, home, draw, away, goals) and top rank it. Use get_match_forecast instead for one match (cheaper). None in the window: a not-available error. Read-only.

dateFrom.description: Optional. First UK date, YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2026-11-28

dateTo.description: Optional. Last UK date, YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2026-11-29

day.description: Optional. One weekday in the window, UK time, e.g. saturday. Example: saturday

detail.description: Optional. full returns every number as data, even when the app shows a tactica. card. Example: full

league.description: Optional. One league: EPL, Championship, League 1 or League 2. Example: Championship

period.description: Optional. today, tomorrow, weekend (Friday to Monday, UK: the current one from Friday, else the next), midweek (Tuesday to Thursday, UK) or next7days (default). Example: weekend

sort.description: Optional. kickoff (default); home, draw or away (that chance, highest first); confidence (the largest of the three, highest first); goals (expected total goals, highest first). Example: confidence

team.description: Optional. Part of a team name, home or away, e.g. Wrexham. Example: Wrexham

top.description: Optional. Return only the first N rows after sorting (1 to 60). Example: 10

name: get_round_forecasts
title: Get the Round Pack of forecasts
